Here's a PyChrono simulation script implementing the specified requirements:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Simulation settings
step_size = 0.001  # 1 ms for real-time simulation
terrain_size = 20.0  # meters

def main():
    # Create Chrono vehicle system
    vehicle_system = veh.ChVehicleSystem()

    # Create HMMWV vehicle
    hmmwv = veh.HMMWV_Vehicle(vehicle_system)
    hmmwv.SetChassisPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1))  # Start 1m above terrain
    hmmwv.SetChassisRotation(chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0))  # Default orientation

    # Configure rigid tires
    for axle in hmmwv.GetAxles():
        for wheel in axle.GetWheels():
            tire = veh.ChRigidTire(vehicle_system, wheel.GetWheelID())
            tire.SetRadius(0.3)  # Tire radius
            tire.SetWidth(0.25)  # Tire width
            wheel.SetTire(tire)

    # Initialize vehicle visualization
    hmmwv.Initialize(True)  # Enable visualization for all components

    # Create Irrlicht visualization
    myapp = veh.ChWheeledVehicleIrrApp(hmmwv.GetVehicle(), "HMMWV on SCM Terrain", irr.dimension2du(1024, 768))
    myapp.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1), 6)  # Chase camera settings
    myapp.AddTypicalLights()
    myapp.AddLogo()
    myapp.AddSkyBox()
    myapp.SetTimestep(step_size)

    # Create SCM deformable terrain
    scm_terrain = veh.ChDeformableTerrainSCM(vehicle_system)
    scm_terrain.SetSize(terrain_size, terrain_size)  # Terrain dimensions
    scm_terrain.SetHeight(-0.1)  # Terrain elevation (z-coordinate)

    # Configure soil parameters
    soil = scm_terrain.GetSoil()
    soil.SetDensity(1500)          # kg/m³
    soil.SetShearModulus(1e6)      # Pa
    soil.SetDamping(0.1)           # Damping coefficient
    soil.SetCohesion(500)          # Cohesion force
    soil.SetFrictionAngle(chrono.CH_C_PI_4)  # 45 degrees friction angle

    # Add moving terrain patch
    moving_patch = scm_terrain.AddPatch(
        veh.ChDeformableTerrainSCM.PatchType.SCM,
        chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0),  # Initial position (will be updated)
        chrono.ChVectorD(terrain_size, terrain_size, 0.1),  # Patch dimensions
        0)  # Layer index
    moving_patch.SetMoving(True)  # Enable dynamic movement

    # Configure terrain visualization
    scm_terrain.SetVisualization(
        veh.ChDeformableTerrainSCM.VISUALIZATION_MESH |
        veh.ChDeformableTerrainSCM.VISUALIZATION_SINKAGE)
    myapp.AddAsset(scm_terrain)  # Add terrain to visualization

    # Initialize terrain system
    vehicle_system.SetTerrain(scm_terrain)
    scm_terrain.Initialize()

    # Setup driver controls
    driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(myapp.GetInputDriver())
    hmmwv.SetDriver(driver)

    # Simulation loop
    time = 0.0
    while myapp.Run():
        # Update driver inputs
        driver.Synchronize(time, hmmwv.GetChassis().GetPos())

        # Update vehicle controls
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time,
            driver.GetSteering(),
            driver.GetThrottle(),
            driver.GetBrake())

        # Update moving terrain patch position
        chassis_pos = hmmwv.GetChassis().GetPos()
        moving_patch.SetPosition(chassis_pos)

        # Advance simulation step
        vehicle_system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)
        time += step_size

        # Limit to real-time
        myapp.DoStepThrottle()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
